LINHA.FILTRO: TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'DDMMYYYY') = to_char(sysdate, 'DDMMYYYY') AND CAB.TIPMOV IN ('V') AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.CODPARC<>3 AND CAB.CODEMP = 3 AND TOP.GOLSINAL = -1
LINHA.COMSELECT: SELECT TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'DDMMYYYY') AS DTNEG, PAR.CGC_CPF, TO_NUMBER( CASE WHEN PAR.AD_NATJURIDICA = 4 THEN 1 WHEN PAR.AD_NATJURIDICA IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 12 WHEN PAR.AD_NATJURIDICA = 5 THEN 63 WHEN PAR.AD_NATJURIDICA = 6 THEN 32 ELSE 00 END ) AS CODSUBCANAL, UFS.UF AS UF, LPAD(PRO.CODPROD, 13, '0') AS CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD AS DESCRPROD, NVL(ITE.QTDNEG,0) AS QTDNEG, (SUBSTR(ITE.ALIQICMS, 1, INSTR(ITE.ALIQICMS, ',') +2) || '00') ALIQICMS, LPAD( REPLACE( TRIM( TO_CHAR(ROUND(ITE.VLRICMS/ITE.QTDNEG,2), '9999999999D99') ), ',' ), 10, '0' ) AS VLRICMS, REPLACE(ITE.VLRSUBST,',','') AS VLRSUBST, '1277' AS CODIQVIA, 'Y' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(CAB.DTNEG)) AS ANO, 'M' || TO_CHAR(MAX(CAB.DTNEG), 'MM') AS MESTITULO, 'D' || LPAD(EXTRACT(DAY FROM MAX(CAB.DTNEG)), 2, '0') AS DIAMES, 'N' AS CONTROLEIQVIA, LPAD( REPLACE( TRIM( TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ITE.QTDNEG = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ( CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV IN ('O', 'C', 'E') THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE ( CASE WHEN NVL((SELECT INTEIRO FROM TSIPAR WHERE CHAVE = 'TIPTABPRECO'), 0) <> 9 THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED + ITE.VLRSUBST + ( CASE WHEN ITE.VLRIPI > 0 AND NVL((SELECT SOMARIPI FROM TGFTOP TP WHERE TP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER), 'N') <> 'N' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END ) END ) END ) / ITE.QTDNEG END), 2), '9999999999D99') ), ',' ), 10, '0' ) AS PREÇOVENDA FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID INNER JOIN TSIUFS UFS ON UFS.CODUF = CID.UF INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER=CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER=CAB.DHTIPOPER /*WHERE TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'DDMMYYYY') = to_char(sysdate, 'DDMMYYYY') AND TIPMOV IN ('V','D') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'DDMMYYYY'), PAR.CGC_CPF, PAR.AD_NATJURIDICA, UFS.UF, LPAD(PRO.CODPROD, 13, '0'), TRIM(PRO.DESCRPROD), ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.ALIQICMS, ITE.VLRICMS, CAB.TIPMOV, ITE.VLRTOT, ITE.VLRDESC, ITE.VLRREPRED, CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.VLRSUBST*/
LINHA.COMGROUPBY: to_char(sysdate, 'DDMMYYYY'), PAR.CGC_CPF, PAR.AD_NATJURIDICA, UFS.UF, LPAD(PRO.CODPROD, 13, '0'), PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.ALIQICMS, ITE.VLRICMS, CAB.TIPMOV, ITE.VLRTOT, ITE.VLRDESC, ITE.VLRREPRED, CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.VLRSUBST, ITE.SEQUENCIA, CAB.DTNEG

LINHA.COMSELECT:
SELECT DT_est,cgc,CODIQVIA,TIPOESTABE,CODPROD,referencia,descrprod,CNPJ_CD,ESTOQUE,ANO,MESTITULO,DIAMES FROM ( SELECT to_char(DATAESTOQUE,'YYYYMMDD') DT_est ,cgc,'1277' AS CODIQVIA,'CD' AS TIPOESTABE, LPAD(CODPROD,13,0) AS CODPROD, referencia, trim(descrprod) AS descrprod, cgc AS CNPJ_CD, SUM(ESTOQUE) as ESTOQUE, 'Y'||extract(YEAR from DATAESTOQUE) AS ANO, 'M'||TO_CHAR(DATAESTOQUE,'MM') as MESTITULO, 'D'||lpad(extract(DAY from DATAESTOQUE),2,'0') as DIAMES
FROM (
SELECT MAX(SYSDATE) AS DATAESTOQUE, PRO.REFERENCIA REFERENCIA,PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD,EMP.CGC,EMP.CODEMP, SUM(NVL( (ITE.QTDNEG * (ITE.ATUALESTOQUE *-1) ) *-1,0)) AS ESTOQUE, ITE.CONTROLE,LOC.CODLOCAL, LOC.DESCRLOCAL
FROM TGFPRO PRO LEFT JOIN TGFITE ITE ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFLOC LOC ON LOC.CODLOCAL = ITE.CODLOCALORIG JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON EMP.CODEMP = ITE.CODEMP
WHERE ITE.CODEMP = 3 -- SOMENTE MATRIZ --AND ITE.CODPROD = :CODPROD AND PRO.REFERENCIA IS NOT NULL AND (ITE.ATUALESTOQUE <> 0 OR ITE.ATUALESTOQUE IS NULL) AND (ITE.RESERVA = 'N' OR ITE.RESERVA IS NULL) AND ( CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN '01/01/2018' AND SYSDATE OR CAB.DTNEG IS NULL) AND PRO.ATIVO = 'S' GROUP BY PRO.REFERENCIA,PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD,EMP.CGC,EMP.CODEMP,ITE.CONTROLE,LOC.CODLOCAL, LOC.DESCRLOCAL HAVING SUM(NVL( (ITE.QTDNEG * (ITE.ATUALESTOQUE *-1) ) *-1,0)) > 0 ) GROUP BY to_char(DATAESTOQUE,'YYYYMMDD') ,cgc,LPAD(CODPROD,13,0), referencia, trim(descrprod), cgc, 'Y'||extract(YEAR from DATAESTOQUE), 'M'||TO_CHAR(DATAESTOQUE,'MM'), 'D'||lpad(extract(DAY from DATAESTOQUE),2,'0'))
